description_en: Sends a created Elastic Desktop Service management message
description_zh: 发送已创建的无影管控消息
name: SendConsoleMessage

parameters.help_en: The ID of the console message to be sent. You can obtain the ID from the return value of the message creation operation or the query result of DescribeConsoleMessages. Each call supports only one message ID, and the message must belong to the current Alibaba Cloud account. Only messages in the Published state can be sent
parameters.help_zh: 待发送的控制台消息 ID。可通过创建消息接口返回值或 DescribeConsoleMessages 查询结果获得。一次调用仅支持一个消息 ID，且消息必须属于当前阿里云账号。当前支持发送 Published 状态的消息
parameters.name: message_id

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use the ID to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的 ID，用于定位和排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is accepted. A value of true indicates success, and a value of false indicates failure. For asynchronous pushes, a successful acceptance does not mean that all targets have received the message
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功受理。true 表示成功，false 表示失败。对于异步推送，成功受理不表示所有目标已经收到消息
